title: image/docker: retry push with missing challenges
body:
when registry allows unauthenticated `GET` requests but require auth for `POST` requests, podman records an empty list of challenges. and when pushing a blob, the `POST` returns `401 Unauthorized`. because the challenges list was empty, podman would fail to retry the request

this patch updates `needsRetryWithUpdatedScope` to catch these missing challenges from the 401 response and populate them. then triggers a retry, allowing the push to authenticate and succeed. protects `c.challenges` with a `sync.RWMutex` for concurrent blob uploads, also adds test coverage for the missing challenges recovery path.

- Fixes: #1009
